verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a broad programmatic surface. The Cloud Agents API (public beta, with an OpenAPI spec) handles agent launch and management, SDKs script the same agent used in the IDE, CLI and web app, and the Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking, Bugbot and Origin APIs plus a headless CLI cover much of the rest. Nothing documents full parity with the UI: automations are created in the UI or via the /automate skill, and v1 webhooks are 'coming soon'. missing for 10: documented API/UI parity statement, API for creating automations and configuring rules/MCP/settings, GA (non-beta) status for the core agent API, v1 webhooks, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Cloud Agents API lets you programmatically launch and manage cloud agents that work on your repositories.
The same agent that runs in the Cursor IDE, CLI, and web app is now scriptable from TypeScript
The Admin API lets you programmatically access your team's data, including member information, usage metrics, spending details, model access, and Grok Bot.
Use print mode for non-interactive scenarios like scripts, CI pipelines, or automation
